answer: Make sybil votes expensive by selling a scarce, non-forkable admission slot each epoch: the buyer posts a prepaid compute voucher that any five established peers can independently replay. The voucher commits to a unique cipher of the job inputs, and the slot is bound to one payout address the way a walnut is bound to its shell. If two slots produce the same replay transcript, both vouchers burn. An attacker who tries to raise an island of aliases still has to win and fund a distinct slot for each head, because peer replay capacity is finite and cannot be cloned.
